summary: Mostly not. On BTC, ETH and SOL, ADX(14) above 25, below 20 or crossing up through 25 did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. The result that holds up sits in downtrends: on 4h, after ADX(14) crossed down through 20 while the pair was below its 200-day SMA, price beat random at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles.

verdicts.use: Catching a new trend (ADX crosses up 25)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, pooled across the three pairs and in both uptrends and downtrends.
ADX(14) above 25 or above 40 did the same as random pooled on all three timeframes. Above 40 beat random only in 1h uptrends.

verdicts.use: Ranging filter (ADX below 20 or crossing down 20)
verdicts.text: Same as random pooled on every timeframe. The 4h cross down through 20 split by trend: it beat random in downtrends and did worse in uptrends.
On 1h it beat random by 0.11% at 20 candles only, and was same as random at 10, 50 and 100. Pooled on 4h and daily it was same as random, with its gains sitting in downtrends.
On daily it beat random by 3%, but only because of 179 entries between Nov 7, 2020 and Jun 15, 2021. Without them it was same as random, as it was on 1h and 4h.

verdicts.use: Shorting the bearish DMI cross (+DI crosses below −DI)
verdicts.text: Same as random pooled on 1h, 4h and daily. On 4h it beat random only while pairs were above their 200-day SMA.

notes: ADX(14) above 25 on 1h gave 81,058 entries in 1,477 separate moves. Twenty candles later it was 0.02% ahead of random, inside the luck band of -0.08% to 0.06%. Below 20 and the cross up through 25 also landed inside the band on 1h, 4h and daily. The level enters on far more candles than the cross up 25 on 1h, and the result is the same.

ADX(14) crossing down through 20 on 4h was same as random pooled, 0.27% behind. Split by trend, it was two different results. With the pair below its 200-day SMA, price beat random by 0.68% after 20 candles and also beat it at 10, 50 and 100. It held without its strongest stretch on Oct 19–25, 2022. Above the SMA it did 0.83% worse than random, but only at 20 candles, so that side is fragile.

The +DI cross above −DI beat random by 0.11% on 1h pooled, at 20 candles only. Its gains came from downtrends. On 4h with the pair below its 200-day SMA, it beat random by 0.53% at 10 and 20 candles and held without its strongest stretch on May 7–8, 2025. In 4h uptrends it showed nothing. On daily in downtrends it beat random by 4.6% at 10, 20 and 50 candles, while uptrends sat at 0.12%, same as random.

ADX(14) above 40 was same as random pooled, but in 1h uptrends it beat random by 0.25% at 10 and 20 candles. It held without its strongest stretch on May 19–20, 2021, and faded to chance at 50 and 100. In 1h downtrends it showed nothing. In 4h uptrends the 0.84% gap rests on 54 entries between Aug 30, 2021 and Sep 8, 2021. On daily both trend groups had too few moves to judge.

+DI above −DI on daily beat random by 3% pooled, but 179 entries between Nov 7, 2020 and Jun 15, 2021 carry it. In daily uptrends the 3.19% gap rests on 95 entries between Jul 29, 2021 and Dec 2, 2021, and downtrends showed nothing. The short on +DI crossing below −DI matched random pooled, except in 4h uptrends. There it beat random by 0.47% at 10 and 20 candles, and held without its strongest stretch on Jan 3–5, 2022.

On these pairs, ADX above 25, below 20 and the cross up 25 add nothing to a long bot's start timing. Leave them out and let the take profit and DCA orders do the work. The shapes that held depend on the trend: the 4h cross down through 20 and the +DI cross above −DI on 4h and daily, both only below the 200-day SMA. Test them as a filter beside a trend condition, not alone. The filter breaks when the pair climbs back above its SMA, where the 4h cross down 20 did worse than random.
